body:
Claim done. The README front-door rewrite landed on main as bffbe9b
(docs: rewrite the README front door — problem first, protocol honest),
rebased onto the 1.1.2 release that crossed it mid-session (36720b9,
self-hosted 0714a2f). Verified: pre-commit gate passed; integration
gate + collab check passed; package suite 35/35 green on the rebase
base; zero path overlap with the 1.1.2 files. ledger-mem lint rc=1 on
the staged diff — all five hits are the pre-existing self-documenting
product class (lint --tree reports 87 hits on the untouched tree);
logged as a protocol flaw in flaws/log.md rather than stripped, since
stripping would remove the product's own name from its docs.
